faq.q: How much does The Husband & Wife Law Team charge?
faq.a: The Husband & Wife Law Team publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does The Husband & Wife Law Team offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. The Husband & Wife Law Team publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock, the firm states it will visit clients in hospital or at home and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does The Husband & Wife Law Team have offices?
faq.a: The Husband & Wife Law Team publishes five offices, among them Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tucson and Mesa. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at The Husband & Wife Law Team?
faq.a: The Husband & Wife Law Team names eight attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Arizona does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
